retired.name: ASTA Testing Services (Intertek)
retired.reason: Its only cited page (intertek.com ASTA certification, fetched 16 Oct 2026) describes ASTA as a certification body for low-voltage products whose testing is done at Recognised Testing Laboratories. It does not support the 400 kV rating, own test bays, the transformer test capabilities, or the UKAS 17025 accreditation listed.
